title: 79 % of frontend_error telemetry is third-party browser noise, and /admin/insights counts it as our errors
description:
## Customer impact

No customer sees this directly. It corrupts the numbers Mew uses to decide what to fix, and it is a measurable share of the database that is already the bottleneck.

## Evidence (14 Bangkok days to 2026-09-12, read-only production SQL)

`TelemetryEvent` where `name='frontend_error'`: **520 rows, 419 sessions, 20 signed-in users**.

| class | rows | share |
|---|---:|---:|
| Android in-app WebView bridge (`Error invoking postMessage: Java object is gone` / `Java exception was raised`) | 393 | 75.6 % |
| MetaMask extension (`Failed to connect to MetaMask`) | 18 | 3.5 % |
| iOS WebView bridge (`window.webkit.messageHandlers`) | 2 | 0.4 % |
| opaque cross-origin `Script error.` | 37 | 7.1 % |
| everything else (ours + Clerk network + unclassified) | 70 | 13.5 % |

All 393 WebView-bridge rows arrive on the public marketing page `/` (357 distinct sessions), at a steady 20 to 42 per Bangkok day, i.e. visitors opening the sale page inside a social app in-app browser.

## Root cause

`src/components/telemetry/telemetry-provider.tsx` attaches `window.addEventListener("error")` and `unhandledrejection` and writes **every** event to `TelemetryEvent` with no origin filter, i.e. none of the `beforeSend` rules that `src/lib/sentry-config.ts` already applies to Sentry (`docs/ops/linear-sentry-observability.md`, Third-party browser noise).

`benignTelemetryReason()` in `src/app/api/admin/insights/route.ts:288` catches `Script error.`, play/pause races, cancels and superseded jobs, but has no rule for the WebView bridge or for extension-injected frames. Replaying its rules over the 14-day window: **413 of 520 rows (79.4 %) are counted as real errors by `/admin/insights`**, and all 413 are third-party.

## The Sentry side is already fixed; the telemetry side is not

PR #463 (`5b861bf8`, merged 2026-09-09T14:29 +07 = 07:29 UTC) started dropping this exact class before it reaches Sentry. The last WebView-bridge event in Sentry is 2026-09-09T07:44 UTC and the last MetaMask event 07:37 UTC; in the 24 hours to 2026-09-11 21:30 UTC the whole project recorded 5 groups / 9 events and none of them are third-party.

Over the same cutoff, `TelemetryEvent` kept writing:

| | before 2026-09-09T07:45Z | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| WebView bridge | 331 | 62 |
| MetaMask | 8 | 10 |
| iOS bridge | 1 | 1 |
| all `frontend_error` | 418 | 102 |

So **73 of the 102 rows (72 %) written since the Sentry filter shipped are the same noise Sentry now refuses**. This is a one-sided fix, not a missing one: the rule already exists and is proven in production, it simply was never applied at the telemetry capture point.
## Expected / actual

Expected: the frontend error rate on `/admin/insights` reflects errors thrown by our code. Actual: four in five of the rows behind it are thrown by a browser extension or an in-app WebView host, so the metric cannot fall below about 79 % noise no matter what we fix.

## Suggested fix

1. Reuse the Sentry third-party rule at the point of capture in `telemetry-provider.tsx` (drop when the stack has an injected-origin frame and no frame of ours, or when the message names an API this app never calls) so the rows are never written.
2. Extend `benignTelemetryReason()` with the same classes so the history already in the table stops inflating the metric.
3. Never filter `failed_to_load_clerk_js` or any sign-in/sign-up error. That exclusion is deliberate (`docs/ops/linear-sentry-observability.md`) and must survive this change.

## Acceptance criteria

* A `scripts/verify-*.ts` check asserts both directions, including a mixed stack where an injected frame sits above our own code (mirror `verify:sentry-config`).
* After the change, `frontend_error` rows carrying the WebView-bridge or extension signature are 0 for 7 days at current traffic.
* `/admin/insights` frontend error count over the same 14-day history drops by the 413 rows identified here, and no sign-in/sign-up or `failed_to_load_clerk_js` row is dropped.
